result.title: Seeing the Right Context: Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Remote Sensing
result.summary: Remote sensing scene understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret queried targets in relation to nearby objects and surrounding structures, which serve as spatial references or define the scope of an answer. However, standard answers and bounding boxes often leave these contextual relationships implicit. Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K to make them explicit in 5,394 training pairs for visual question answering (VQA), with spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. GeOPD uses these annotations for on-policy distillation, guiding a frozen teacher with region marks on the full image and a visual fact while preserving surrounding spatial references. It prioritizes teacher corrections that agree with the shift in the student's next token distribution when evidence is restored. A complementary objective weights the contrast between the student's scores on the two views by how much masking lowers the teacher's log probability for the same sampled token. Experiments on five remote sensing VQA benchmarks show that GeOPD outperforms the evaluated open-source MLLMs and matched post-training baselines, improving over the 4B and 9B base models by 5.81 and 2.97 percentage points on average. The dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 GeoContext-5K 遥感 VQA 数据集，用显式空间线索、视觉事实与支撑区域标注，并据此设计 GeOPD 的 on-policy 蒸馏，让冻结教师通过区域标记和视觉事实提供纠正信号，在五个遥感 VQA 基准上优于开源 MLLM 与匹配的后训练基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用「证据恢复」前后两视图的分布偏移筛选教师纠正、并按遮蔽引起的 log 概率下降加权对比，可用于核查视觉证据贡献分配与语言先验旁路诊断；但它属任务级后训练，是否触及内部 latent 状态与推理期证据获取逻辑仍需读原文确认。
